tasks.instruction: Return the unique integers from the input list, preserving first occurrence order. Empty input returns [].

Input is a duration string MM:SS or HH:MM:SS. Components must be nonnegative ASCII digits; seconds and minutes must be less than 60. Return total seconds or null for invalid input. Hours may exceed 23. Whitespace and signs are invalid.

Input is a list of closed integer intervals [start,end], each start <= end. Return their sorted union merging intervals that overlap or share an endpoint. Do not merge merely adjacent integers with different endpoints. Empty input returns [].

Convert the input string to a slug: lowercase ASCII letters A-Z; retain ASCII letters a-z and digits; replace each run of other characters with one hyphen; trim leading/trailing hyphens. Unicode letters are separators, not transliterated.
Return whether (), [] and {} are properly balanced and nested in an input string. Ignore all other characters. Empty string is balanced.
Input is {values: list of numbers, window: positive integer}. Return averages of complete consecutive windows, in order. Return [] when window exceeds list length. Do not round.
